title: Tenant isolation model
audience: developers-first (single operator / small team before billing)
decision: directory-per-tenant under CAREER_OPS_ROOT/tenants/{tenantId}/ with auth gate before path resolution

auth_provider.poc: single shared operator secret / Railway private networking (no multi-user login yet)
auth_provider.next: Clerk or Auth.js (GitHub OAuth) — tenantId from session claim; never from client path params alone

isolation.contains: full career-ops user-layer tree (cv.md, config/, data/, reports/, output/, modes/_profile.md, portals.yml)
isolation.forbid: shared CAREER_OPS_ROOT for all users in production

api_rule: Resolve tenant from authenticated session → set effective CAREER_OPS_ROOT = /data/tenants/{id}; refuse cross-tenant path traversal

alternatives_rejected.why: FAIL AC — leaks CV/tracker across tenants
Breaks career-ops scripts that expect markdown on disk
